newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Five Rio youths may have been shot for being rowdy.
newsitem.headline: Five Rio youths may have been shot for being rowdy.

text.p: Five youths found dead on Friday in a Rio suburb were probably shot and killed for being rowdy on a bus and jeering at other passengers, Brazilian police said.
A police spokesman said the five youths were forced off the bus and shot by three men who were most likely annoyed by their behaviour.
Local news agency Agencia Estado reported the three men may have been security guards of the bus company who were travelling on the bus disguised as passengers.
The guards forced the boys off the bus when they refused to pay the bus fare and shot them, Agencia Estado said. The report could not be independently confirmed.
